why_ai: Network optimisers and LTV models already automate much of buying; humans mostly manage heavy-tail uncertainty.
why_clarity: Payback and ROAS are measurable numbers, but true lifetime value resolves only months later.
why_digital: Spend, bids, creatives and player data all live in ad networks and analytics.

why_ai: Allocation and bid optimisation are increasingly done by the networks' own automated optimisers.
why_clarity: Constant repeated bid decisions against a numeric target, with feedback lagging days.
why_digital: Budgets and bids are set in ad network dashboards and APIs.

why_ai: Consumer protection attention adds some accountability, but the measurement itself is long-horizon analytics.
why_clarity: Whether misleading-ad installs are worth anything is measured separately and late.
why_digital: Ad creatives and cohort revenue data, analyzed entirely in software.

why_ai: Generating, formatting, localising and trafficking variants is a mechanical factory generative AI is taking over.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical variants a month, each tested quickly, though concept quality is taste.
why_digital: Video and image assets produced on screen and shipped to networks.

why_ai: Transfer valuation is a modelling job; the human part is internal negotiation between game teams.
why_clarity: The cost of moving a player between titles has never been measured and resolves over months.
why_digital: Player movement and spend data across a publisher's own games.

why_ai: Modelling over cohort data the UA team already holds, bought and deployed as software.
why_clarity: Every cohort repeats the prediction, but whether whales were caught is known only months later.
why_digital: Early player behaviour logs in, predicted value distributions out.

why_ai: Test design, execution and readout are an operational pipeline that software makes routine.
why_clarity: Holdout lift is a defined statistic from codified test design, read after weeks.
why_digital: Holdouts run in ad networks and are read from install and revenue data.

why_ai: LTV prediction from early behaviour is a modelling problem software owns.
why_clarity: Realized value eventually settles the forecast, but only after months of player spending.
why_digital: Cohort telemetry in, predicted value out, feeding bid systems.

why_ai: Causal decomposition across cohorts and release history is hard analysis, but entirely software work.
why_clarity: No ground truth separates cohort quality from what the game shipped afterward.
why_digital: Cohort revenue and release history data, analyzed in software.

why_ai: Building small games to tight size and format limits is code work AI coding tools increasingly handle.
why_clarity: Five-megabyte budget and network format checks pass or fail at once; the fun factor is creative.
why_digital: Code in, playable HTML ads out, shipped to ad networks.

why_ai: Sources, bids and creative choices are increasingly automated; accountability for payback is the human residue.
why_clarity: Payback is a number, but mostly caused by content another team ships over six months.
why_digital: Campaign dashboards, cohort data and reporting, all on screen.
